name: Exponential Heun 2 (x0, SDE)
plain: Same preset with noise on (η=1). Because r=1 the intermediate stage already sits at σ', so the noise drawn for it is carried straight through to the final state. Default noise is plain seeded Gaussian, not a Brownian tree.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
As seeds_2 with r=1, phi_2. Stage noise e₁=√(1−e^{−2hη})·n; x₂ gets e₁·σ'·s_noise. Final segment factor is 0, so e₂=e₁ and x' gets e₁·σ'·s_noise (the same draw).
h_η=h(1+η); x₂=(σ'/σ)e^{−hη}x−α'(e^{−h_η}−1)D; x' uses b₂=ei_h_phi_2(−h_η), b₁=(e^{−h_η}−1)−b₂.

props.flow_const: Half-logSNR with CONST logit, first-sigma offset, s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: SamplerSEEDS2 reaches the same settings: phi_2, r=1, eta=1, s_noise=1.

label: from code
surprise: With r=1 the noise injected before the second model call is reused unchanged in the output; a second noise sample is drawn then multiplied by 0.
